title: withdrawal/v2
description: nodes/<id>/withdrawals/<timestamp>-<author>.yaml or, for a definition module's gloss, targets/<id>/withdrawals/<timestamp>-<author>.yaml (F08-T31, F20-R7; D-14, D-18 v3.27, D-3 v3.30): withdraws one status record, defect claim, gloss version or explainer version, with a reason. A status record or defect claim is withdrawn by a listed curator; a gloss or explainer version by its author, an active steward of the target or a listed curator. Append-only. The withdrawn file stays in the tree and every reader reads it as absent. Versioned, never edited (D-34).

withdraws.description: The record withdrawn, relative to the directory holding withdrawals/: status/<file>, defects/<file>, gloss/<hash>.md or explainer/<hash>.md.

reason.description: Why, in the author's words: the published reasoning a withdrawal owes the record (D-22).

author.description: The withdrawing pseudonym: a listed curator, or for a gloss or explainer its author or an active steward of the target.
